chapter.verse: Tu-a teng khitzawh, vantung ah mihon tampite' awging lianpi ahihtuak khat, hih bangin ka za hi, “Hallelujah! Hotkhiatna, minphatna leh vangliatna i Pasian' a ahi hi.

a hang pen ama' thukhennate thumaanin thutang hi; ama' tatkhialhna tawh leitung a ninsak numei kizuaknu a lianpi' tungah thukhen khin a, ama' silate' sisan taangin tua numei' tungah phu la khinta hi.”
Amaute hih bangin khatvei kiko lai uh hi, “Hallelujah! Tua numei' kiangpana meikhu a tawntung a tawntungin kahto hi.”
Tua ciangin makai sawmnih-le-lite leh sahing lite puksukin kumpi-tokhom tunga a tu Pasian bia uh a, “Amen. Hallelujah!” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi-tokhom pan awging khat in hih bangin ci hi: “Pasian a kihta, no ama' silate aw, a neu a lian na vekpi-un i Pasian phat un.”
Tua ciangin mihon tampite' awging ahihtuak khat ka za a, tui tampi ging leh kekkia nakpi ging bangin kiko hi: “Hallelujah! Topa i Pasian Vanglianpa kumpi suak ta hi.
Eite lungdamin kipakin amah minpha pia ni; a hang pen Tuuno mopawi hong tung ta a, ama' mo nungak zong amahmah kigingsa-in om ta hi;
puannel a paak leh a siang silh theih ding phalna ama' tungah kipia hi.” Puannel cih ciangin mi siangthote' dik gamtatna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin vanmi in kei' kiangah, “Hih thu gelh in: Tuuno mopawi nitak anvakna ah sapna a ngahte thuphangah ahi hi,” hong cih khit ciangin, “Hih thute Pasian' kammal taktak ahi hi,” hong ci hi.

Kei zong a khe-phung ah boksukin amah bia dingin ka kithawi leh amah in, “Tuaci kei in! Kei pen Jesu' teci panna a zui nang leh na sanggampihte' silapih khat ka hi lel hi. Pasian bia in,” hong ci hi. A hang pen Jesu' thu teci panna mah kamsanna laigil ahi hi.
Tua ciangin vantung kihong ka mu a, en un, sakol kang khat om hi. A tunga tuangpa pen Muantaak leh Thutak kici a, amah in dikna tawh thu khenin gal do hi.
A mittangte meikuang tawh kibangin a lu tungah kumpi-dialkhip tampi khim a, amah longal kuamah dang' theih loh min a kigelh khat zong nei hi.
Sisan sunga kidiah puantual khat silh a, amah a kisapna min pen Pasian' Kammal ahi hi.
Tua ciangin puannel a paak a siang a silh vantung galkapte in sakol kangte' tungah tuangin amah zui uh hi.
Minamte a vat nading namsau hiam khat a kam sungpan pusuak hi. Amah in sik ciangkhut tawh minamte uk ding a, Vanglian Pasian' lungsona ahi lengtui bawlna bung tuancil ding hi.
A puantual tung leh a phei tungah, kumpite' Kumpi leh topate' Topa, ci-in min khat kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin vanmi khat ni sungah a ding ka mu a, vankim lai-a leng vasate khempeuh awging lianpi tawh samin, “Hong pai un, Pasian' nitak annek pawipi ah hong kikaikhawm unla
kumpite' sa, galkap bute' sa, mithahatte' sa, sakolte leh a tunga tuangte' sa, sila hileh tualmi suakta hileh mihing citeng ii sate, ne un,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin sapi leh leitung kumpite ka mu a, sakol tunga tuangpa leh a galkapte do nadinga a kaihkhop uh amau' galkapte zong om uh hi.

Tua ciangin sapi kiman a, sapi ciaptehna lim a ngahsa mite leh sapi milim a bia mite a khemna-in sapi' mai-ah kihilna limte a bawl kamsang zuaupa zong sapi tawh kimankhawm hi. Hihte nih pen kaat tawh a kuang meili sungah a hingtangin kilawnsuk hi.
A omlai teng ahihleh sakol tung tuangpa' kam sungpana pusuak namsau tawh thahlup thuak uh a, a sa uh vasa citeng in gilvahtak ne uh hi.
